notes: Account background: 20+ brands, heavy personalization stack, migrating away from partial in-house model serving.
Primary workload: real-time product ranking + cross-session personalization vectors; also chat-assisted returns agent for call centers.
Throughput targets discussed: sustained 4k RPS at 128-token requests during peak for top-line brand; burst capacity to 12k RPS for launches.
Latency SLOs: target p95 <120ms; willing to accept higher p99 for large contexts if documented fallbacks exist.
Reserved GPU planning: asking for GPU sizing guidance — prefer quarterly reserved pools + surge bursting. wants worked example for 8, 16, 32 A100-equivalent planning.
Model preferences: open-vendor mix (Llama-derived and a proprietary fine-tuned ranking model). emphasis on 8k-16k context for combined session state + product history.
Quantization concerns: engineering team worried about quality regression with aggressive 4-bit profiles on reranking. requests Redwood Optimize recommendations and test harness.

Batching/KV cache notes: observed that continuous batching improved throughput but increases tail latency for single-shot chat. customer wants policy to prioritize latency-sensitive routes and batch others. explicit request for per-route batching configs and KV cache eviction settings.
Security/compliance notes: must support SSO (SAML), customer-managed KMS, audit logs for model inputs/outputs, and EU data residency for EU brands. Legal has data residency redline.
Quote from Head of ML: "We need predictable dollars-per-token for forecasts — show us reserved-capacity math with model-variant fallbacks."
POC observations: KV cache warmup cut p99 by ~60% for sessions with repeated context. but cross-session context length drives memory pressure; request quantization + offloading guidance.

Action items captured in call: (1) provide dedicated capacity sizing doc (scenarios: steady, holiday, product launch) (2) share Optimize runbook for quantization testing (3) propose SLA language for throughput guarantees and model fallback credits.
Commercial: procurement flagged need for a 60-day review clause and operational playbook before committing to annual reserved pools.

SE note: recommend trial with 12 A100-equiv reserved for 6 weeks using mixed-precision then run Optimize to propose 8-bit quant profiles + KV caching policy. track eval metrics: rerank NDCG delta, p99, cost per 1M tokens.
Customer sentiment: pragmatic but risk-averse; willing to sign if SLA covers prioritized routes and provides automatic fallback to cheaper variants with documented quality thresholds.
